mainEntity.name: Is an 18K4G engine the same as an 18K4F?

acceptedAnswer.text: They are closely related 1.8 K-Series engines, but they can differ in engine management and ancillaries. We check your engine number and VIN before recommending a compatible replacement for your Freelander.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 18K4G engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a K-Series engine for sale without fitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Freelander 1 18K4G engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any cooling parts needed and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote tailored to your Freelander.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 18K4G engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver Freelander 1 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Freelander to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does an 18K4G engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.
